We need to determine appropriate charge(s) for the described case.

Facts: Wu2 (吴2某) from March to August 2014, posted low-price sale of smuggled cars (走私车) online, virtual info, got victims to pay shipping fees, then fabricated that they must pay part or all of car price to receive car, victims transferred money to accounts under names "Deng" and "Huang". Total amount 331,094 yuan. Evidence includes bank records, etc. Public prosecution says Wu2 used false facts to defraud others, amount huge, should be charged.

Thus the crime is fraud (诈骗) specifically maybe "诈骗" (general). Could also be "走私普通货物、物品" but the smuggled cars are the subject of the fraud, but the crime is not smuggling but fraud. The charge list includes "诈骗". Also there is "走私普通货物、物品" but the act is selling smuggled cars? He is not actually selling cars, just fraud. The smuggled cars are not actually delivered. So the main charge is "诈骗". Also maybe "非法占有" but that's part of fraud. The list includes "诈骗". So answer: [罪名]诈骗<eoa>.

Check if any other charge like "走私普通货物、物品" is appropriate. The facts: He posted low-price sale of smuggled cars (走私车). He is not actually transporting smuggled cars; he is just fraud. The crime of smuggling is separate, but he didn't actually smuggle; he just claimed to have smuggled cars. So not smuggling.

Thus final answer: 诈骗.
